canonical_data: conversations, messages, agents, prompts, files, and per-user memory entries in an operator-run MongoDB
strengths: Routes Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Bedrock, Google, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint through one workspace
A hash-chained immutable audit log with ACL, role, and group permissions gives operators real multi-tenant governance
Re-exposes its own agents over chat-completions and Open Responses endpoints, so the workspace is also an addressable backend
weaknesses: Package manifests declare ISC while the license file and GitHub both report MIT
Memory entries are keyed upserts with no revision history, so an automatic write overwrites the prior value
File search needs MongoDB, Meilisearch, pgvector, and a separate retrieval API before it works
why_it_matters: The most complete open self-hosted counterpart to hosted multi-model assistants, holding conversations, agents, and permissions in infrastructure the operator controls.
